description: The delegate option is inside collapsed Details. A user whose agent needs it (an orchestrator) sees nothing on the main card; llms.txt tells agents the other options are optional. If it is missed, the later `grant` fails and the agent has to be reconnected.
expected: Agent can ask for delegate in its login so the page shows it, or the main card hints at it.

description: The summary line says 'can add other agents' but the done card says only 'read, write, delete and share its new drive'; the permission just granted is not confirmed.

On the worker request the summary reads 'ravi-lead · can read and write · offered by ravi-lead' because the drive and the offering agent share a name; it repeats the same word and does not name the worker's drive clearly.
At 390 px the verification input is 168 px wide (label beside it); see SETUP-017-01.
